meta.name: coding-agent-sessions
meta.description: Finds, reads, and reconstructs coding-agent sessions across Codex, Claude, OpenCode, OMO/Senpi, and other local agent logs. Use when asked to find or search past sessions, transcripts, or subagent runs, or to recover what an earlier session did.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查找编码助手的历史会话,还原此前做过什么
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要找回之前 AI 编程会话干了什么,避免重复劳动。
copy.tagline_en: Find past coding-agent sessions and see what was done before
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use coding agents and need to recover what an earlier session did.

howto.what: 回答前会先查你本地的编码 agent 会话记录：跨平台搜索过去的会话、转录和子代理运行，读回某次会话的提问、事件与子会话，并可按平台、时间、目录、模型筛选。
howto.when: 当你要求查找、搜索过去的会话、转录或子代理运行，或想还原某次会话做过什么时触发，包括“前几天在忙什么”这类回忆式提问。未指定平台时会并行搜索所有已注册平台。

say.text: 帮我找上周改 proxy 的那些会话
say.note: 跨平台搜索并列出匹配结果

say.text: 读一下这个会话 <session-id>，看它都做了什么
say.note: 返回首次/末次提问、事件和子会话

say.text: 搜一下我们是不是已经迁移过 X，记得带上子代理
say.note: 把委派出去的子会话也算进搜索

howto.what_en: Claude searches your local coding-agent sessions before answering: past sessions, transcripts and subagent runs across platforms, then reads back a session's prompts, events and child sessions; filter by platform, date, cwd, model.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to find, read or recover a past session, transcript or subagent run, or recall questions about earlier work. No platform named: it searches all registered platforms in parallel.

say_en.text: Find the sessions where I changed the proxy last week
say_en.note: Runs the finder across platforms and lists matches

say_en.text: Read session <session-id> and show what it did
say_en.note: Returns first/last prompts, events and subagents

say_en.text: Search whether we already migrated X, include subagents
say_en.note: Includes delegated child sessions in the search
